<a id="desired-state-activationrequirement"></a>
#### `$defs/ActivationRequirement` (string)

Either a safe-state signal name (must be true in the device's safe-state provider, e.g. machine_parked, operator_confirmed) or 'plc:<deploymentId>[@<FLEX01 hash>]': hold until the plc-verify driver has verified that deployment (at that hash) on this device.

Closed object: other keys are refused.

<a id="desired-state-dependson"></a>
#### `$defs/DependsOn` (array of object)

Deployment ordering on this device (EV-42): this deployment is installed or updated only once every listed deployment of the same desired state runs its desired release (condition started) and is healthy (condition healthy, the default); until then it stays Pending ('held: waiting for <ids>', FE-GATE-004) on its previous version.

<a id="desired-state-runstate"></a>
#### `$defs/RunState` (enum `staged`, `running`, `stopped`)

FE-4: the run state of an installed deployment. running (default, as before FE-4): installed, started, health-gated. staged: installed (artefacts fetched, verified, prepared on the executor) but not started; no health gate (status Staged). stopped: installed and stopped, kept with its build for a fast restart (status Stopped).

<a id="desired-state-runtime"></a>
#### `$defs/Runtime` (enum `docker`, `docker-compose`, `podman`, `ankaios`, `systemd`, `process`, `applab`, `mcu-module`)

FE-4: the runtime that runs this deployment (the device reports the runtimes it allows as capabilities x-flex.runtimes; engine.yaml lists them per profile).

<a id="desired-state-runtimeprofiles"></a>
#### `$defs/RuntimeProfiles` (`{"docker": "container", "docker-compose": "container", "podman": "container", "ankaios": "container", "systemd": "native", "process": "native", "applab": "applab", "mcu-module": "mcu-module"}`)

FE-4: the driver profile of each x-flex-runtime value (a reference table, read by flexengine2.contracts; not applied to documents).

<a id="desired-state-build"></a>
#### `$defs/Build` (object)

FE-4: build this deployment on the device from the source payload of its signed release (layer application/vnd.flex.payload.source.v1.tar+gzip of the deployment's profile; the build spec is the release descriptor's `build`) before it is staged or started, once per id.

| Field | Type | Req. | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | ✔ | Build id chosen by the control plane; the engine builds once per id and names it in every build event (buildId). |

Closed object: other keys are refused.

## CP-3 Artefact access (OCI subset) and offline bundle

### `oci-profile.v1alpha1.schema.json`

- `$id`: `https://flex.dev/schemas/oci-profile.v1alpha1.schema.json`
- Title: CP-3 OCI artefact access profile v1alpha1
- Version: `v1alpha1`

The OCI image-manifest / referrers subset the engine reads (artefacts/store.py), written by the release tools (flex release; testing/release.py) and served by flexCloud's /v2/ subset (testing/fakecloud.py).

<a id="oci-profile-digest"></a>
#### `$defs/Digest` (`desired-state.v1alpha1.schema.json#/$defs/Digest`)

<a id="oci-profile-payloadmediatype"></a>
#### `$defs/PayloadMediaType` (enum `application/vnd.flex.payload.image.docker-archive.v1.tar`, `application/vnd.flex.payload.native.v1.tar+gzip`, `application/vnd.flex.payload.applab-release.v1.tar+gzip`, `application/vnd.flex.payload.mcu-module.v1+flxm`, `application/vnd.flex.payload.mcu-firmware.v1+mcuboot`, `application/vnd.flex.payload.plc-artefact.v1.tar+gzip`, `application/vnd.flex.payload.os-rauc.v1+raucb`, `application/vnd.flex.payload.arduino-ota.v1+ota`, `application/vnd.flex.payload.system.v1+json`, `application/vnd.flex.payload.compose.v1.tar+gzip` …)

FE-4 additions: compose.v1.tar+gzip (profile container, runtime docker-compose: a compose file plus images/*.tar docker archives; the engine runs it with `up --pull never`, so only the signed images run) and source.v1.tar+gzip (the source of an on-device build, x-flex-build; never run as is: the engine picks it only to build, and a release may carry it next to, or instead of, the binary payload).

<a id="cp-4"></a>
## CP-4 Trust

### `trust.v1alpha1.schema.json`

- `$id`: `https://flex.dev/schemas/trust.v1alpha1.schema.json`
- Title: CP-4 Trust objects v1alpha1
- Version: `v1alpha1`

Signed objects and trust anchors the engine verifies (identity/crypto.py, artefacts/store.py, core/reconciler.py).

<a id="trust-b64"></a>
#### `$defs/B64` (string)

<a id="trust-ed25519publickey"></a>
#### `$defs/Ed25519PublicKey` (string)

base64 of the raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key.

<a id="trust-ed25519signature"></a>
#### `$defs/Ed25519Signature` (string)

base64 of the raw 64-byte Ed25519 signature.

<a id="trust-keyid"></a>
#### `$defs/KeyId` (string)

'ed25519:' + first 16 hex chars of sha256(raw public key) (crypto.key_id).

<a id="trust-signatureenvelope"></a>
#### `$defs/SignatureEnvelope` (object)

Layer blob (mediaType application/vnd.flex.signature.v1+json) of a release signature manifest. signature = Ed25519 over the exact bytes base64-decoded from payload.

| Field | Type | Req. | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `payload` | [B64](#trust-b64) | ✔ | base64 of the canonical-JSON SignedPayload. |
| `signature` | [Ed25519Signature](#trust-ed25519signature) | ✔ |  |
| `keyid` | [KeyId](#trust-keyid) | ✔ | Selects the trusted release key; an unknown keyid = 'untrusted key'. |

Closed object: other keys are refused.

<a id="trust-safetyapproval"></a>
#### `$defs/SafetyApproval` (object)

Approval proof for safety-relevant releases.

| Field | Type | Req. | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `approved` | boolean | ✔ |  |
| `approvers` | array of string | ✔ |  |
| `role` | string |  | Role of the approvers (e.g. safety-engineer); informational on the device. |

Closed object: other keys are refused.

<a id="trust-signedpayload"></a>
#### `$defs/SignedPayload` (object)

cosign 'simple signing'-shaped payload.

| Field | Type | Req. | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `critical` | object | ✔ |  |
| `optional` | object | ✔ |  |

Closed object: other keys are refused.

<a id="trust-requestsignatureheaders"></a>
#### `$defs/RequestSignatureHeaders` (object)

Headers of a signed device request (crypto.sign_request).

| Field | Type | Req. | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `X-Flex-Device` | `desired-state.v1alpha1.schema.json#/$defs/DeviceId` | ✔ |  |
| `X-Flex-Date` | string | ✔ | Unix milliseconds; the cloud accepts +-300 s. |
| `X-Flex-Nonce` | string | ✔ | 12 random bytes, hex; the cloud keeps a bounded replay cache. |
| `X-Flex-Signature` | [Ed25519Signature](#trust-ed25519signature) | ✔ |  |

<a id="trust-trustanchors"></a>
#### `$defs/TrustAnchors` (object)

Trust-anchor keys of one device engine's effective configuration (the dict core.reconciler.Engine and cloud.client read; where they sit in the config file is the EV-04 config schema's business).

| Field | Type | Req. | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cloudPublicKey` | [Ed25519PublicKey](#trust-ed25519publickey) | ✔ | Verifies X-Flex-Manifest-Signature / desired.sig; must equal the onboarding response's cloudPublicKey. |
| `releasePublicKeys` | array of [Ed25519PublicKey](#trust-ed25519publickey) | ✔ | Trusted release signers (selected by keyid). |
| `caFile` | string |  | Pinned CA (PEM) for https apiUrl; https without it is refused unless allowSystemTrust. |
| `tlsServerName` | string |  | Hostname to verify instead of the apiUrl host. |
| `allowSystemTrust` | boolean |  |  |

## CP-5 Driver SPI v1

### `driver-spi.v1.schema.json`

- `$id`: `https://flex.dev/schemas/driver-spi.v1.schema.json`
- Title: CP-5 Driver SPI v1 (SPI 1.0)
- Version: `v1`

Machine-readable part of the driver SPI (connection point CP-5): the data a driver receives and returns ($defs) and its members (x-flex-spi).

<a id="driver-spi-workload"></a>
#### `$defs/Workload` (object)

Driver input: the verified, executor-ready description of one release revision, built by the reconciler from CP-1 and the verified release (CP-3/CP-4).

| Field | Type | Req. | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dep_id` | string | ✔ | deployment id (CP-1 metadata.id) |
| `module` | string | ✔ | CP-1 spec.applicationId |
| `version` | string | ✔ | release revision |
| `digest` | string | ✔ | release manifest digest: the identity of what runs |
| `payload_path` | string | ✔ | verified payload in the engine's content-addressed store |
| `payload_annotations` | map of string | ✔ | annotations of the payload layer (CP-3) |
| `parameters` | object |  | CP-1 spec.parameters |
| `health` | object |  | the signed descriptor's health probe (CP-1 descriptor) |
| `restart` | object |  | the signed descriptor's restart policy |
| `run_options` | object |  | the signed descriptor's runOptions |
| `build` | object |  | FE-4: the on-device build of this workload, {} when it was not built on the device |

Closed object: other keys are refused.

Driver output of status() and list(): what the executor runs for one deployment.

| Field | Type | Req. | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `present` | boolean | ✔ | False only for an unknown deployment, never for an unreachable executor |
| `running` | boolean |  |  |
| `digest` | string or null |  |  |
| `version` | string or null |  |  |
| `restarts` | integer |  |  |
| `detail` | string |  |  |

Closed object: other keys are refused.

#### `$defs/SuperviseEvent` (object)

One element of supervise(): local supervision the driver did this tick.

| Field | Type | Req. | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dep` | string | ✔ |  |
| `event` | enum `restarted`, `start-limit-hit`, `exited`, `boot-confirmed` | ✔ |  |
| `restarts` | integer |  |  |
| `willRestartAt` | number or null |  | unix seconds of the next start (exited) |

<a id="driver-spi-buildrequest"></a>
#### `$defs/BuildRequest` (object)

FE-4 driver input of build(): one on-device build (the callable emit is not part of the data).

Normative text: the module docstring of `src/flexengine2/drivers/base.py`. Guide for driver authors: [../docs/spi-guide.md](../docs/spi-guide.md).

| Member | Kind | Signature / default |
|---|---|---|
| `profile` | class attribute | `'?'` |
| `name` | class attribute | `'?'` |
| `exclusive` | class attribute | `False` |
| `max_deployments` | class attribute | `None` |
| `reboots_on_apply` | class attribute | `False` |
| `repairs_digest_drift` | class attribute | `True` |
| `runtime` | class attribute | `None` |
| `apply` | required | `apply(self, current: 'Workload \| None', desired: 'Workload') -> 'None'` |
| `build` | optional (default in base) | `build(self, desired: 'Workload', request: 'BuildRequest') -> 'BuildResult'` |

| `platform` | optional (default in base) | `platform(self) -> 'dict \| None'` |
| `preflight` | optional (default in base) | `preflight(self, release, dep: 'dict') -> 'str \| None'` |
| `remove` | required | `remove(self, dep_id: 'str') -> 'None'` |
| `stage` | optional (default in base) | `stage(self, current: 'Workload \| None', desired: 'Workload') -> 'None'` |
| `start` | optional (default in base) | `start(self, dep_id: 'str') -> 'None'` |
| `status` | required | `status(self, dep_id: 'str') -> 'Observed'` |
| `stop` | optional (default in base) | `stop(self, dep_id: 'str') -> 'None'` |
| `supervise` | optional (default in base) | `supervise(self) -> 'list[dict]'` |
| `failure_detail` | optional, looked up by name (no base default) | `failure_detail(self, dep_id, healthy_at) -> dict` |
| `verified` | profile extension (plc-verify only) | `verified(self, dep_id, want) -> bool` |

### [cp5-driver-spi.md](cp5-driver-spi.md)

- Shape
- How the reconciler calls it (`core/reconciler.py`)
- Driver: os-rauc (EV-17, `drivers/os_rauc.py`)
- Driver: arduino-ota (EV-38, `drivers/arduino_ota.py`)
- In-tree drivers
  - `container`: health types, CPU layers, run options (EV-39, EV-40, EV-41)
  - `native`, both drivers: own Python dependencies and platform layers (EV-36, EV-37)
  - `native` / `systemd` (EV-19)

## CP-6 Child-device interfaces

### [cp6-children.md](cp6-children.md)

- 1. MCU (flexEngine-MCU base image) — `drivers/mcu/{link,driver,flxm}.py`
- 2. App Lab (Arduino UNO Q) — `drivers/applab/{driver,ard,rpc}.py`

| Method | Path | Summary | Request | Responses |

| GET | `/v1/health` | engine liveness (also used for the systemd watchdog) |  | 200 (Health), 503 (Health), 401 |
| GET | `/v1/status` |  |  | 200 (cli-status.v1), 401 |
| GET | `/v1/devices/{deviceId}/deployments/{dep}` |  |  | 200 (Deployment), 404 (Problem), 401 |

## CP-8 Telemetry

### `telemetry.v1.schema.json`

- `$id`: `https://flex.dev/schemas/telemetry.v1.schema.json`

- Version: `v1`

Machine-readable part of CP-8: what the engine emits for observability.

<a id="telemetry-loglevel"></a>
#### `$defs/LogLevel` (enum `debug`, `info`, `warning`, `error`)

<a id="telemetry-logevent"></a>
#### `$defs/LogEvent` (enum `log`, `local-api`, `onboarded`, `offline`, `capabilities.sent`, `manifest.accepted`, `manifest.refused`, `manifest.unsupported`, `state.refused`, `prepare.deferred` …)

Event names of engine log records. action.<ActionKind> and build.<phase> are listed by pattern in LogRecord.event; stdlib records of the flexengine2 package carry their logger name.

| `event` | [LogEvent](#telemetry-logevent) or string or string or string | ✔ |  |
| `dep` | string |  |  |
| `version` | string |  |  |
| `msg` | string | ✔ |  |

| `digest` | string or null |  |  |
| `reason` | string |  | reject |

<a id="southbound-api"></a>
## Southbound HTTP API

### `openapi-southbound.yaml`

- Title: flexCloud device API (southbound), as flexEngineV2 uses it
- Version: `v1alpha1`

| Method | Path | Summary | Request | Responses |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/onboarding` | Register the device public key with a one-time token (unsigned) | application/json | 201 (OnboardingResponse), 403 (Problem), 503 |
| PUT | `/api/v1/devices/{deviceId}/capabilities` |  | application/json | 200, 401, 403, 503 |
| GET | `/api/v1/devices/{deviceId}/deployments` |  |  | 200 (DesiredState), 304, 401, 403, 503 |
| POST | `/api/v1/devices/{deviceId}/deployments/{deploymentId}/status` |  | application/json | 200, 401, 403, 503 |
| POST | `/api/v1/devices/{deviceId}/events` | Device-level event (added 2026-10-17): a refused desired state, once per distinct (document, reason); FE-4: the events of an on-device build (BuildStarted, … | application/json | 200, 401, 403, 503 |
| GET | `/api/v1/devices/{deviceId}/bundle` | Offline bundle (tar, bundle.v1alpha1.md): desired.json, desired.sig and every referenced blob |  | 200, 401, 403, 503 |
| GET | `/v2/{repository}/manifests/{digest}` |  |  | 200, 401, 404 (Problem), 503 |
| GET | `/v2/{repository}/blobs/{digest}` |  |  | 200, 401, 404 (Problem), 503 |
| GET | `/v2/{repository}/referrers/{digest}` |  |  | 200 (ReferrersIndex), 401, 503 |
| POST | `/api/v1/admin/onboarding-tokens` |  |  | 201 |
| GET | `/api/v1/admin/devices` | fleet.read |  | 200 |
| GET | `/api/v1/admin/devices/{deviceId}` |  |  | 200 |
| GET | `/api/v1/admin/devices/{deviceId}/bundle` |  |  | 200 |
| POST | `/api/v1/admin/plans` | deploy.plan - resolve releases to digests, diff against current desired state, hash | application/json | 201 (Plan), 422 |
| POST | `/api/v1/admin/plans/{planHash}/approve` | second-person approval (approver != requester) |  | 200, 403 |
| POST | `/api/v1/admin/plans/{planHash}/apply` | deploy.apply - publishes exactly the planned desired state as manifestVersion+1 | application/json | 200, 403, 409 |
| POST | `/api/v1/admin/releases` | upload a release (tar of an OCI image layout) | application/x-tar | 201, 422 |
| GET | `/api/v1/admin/audit` | append-only, hash-chained audit log (FC-S4) |  | 200 |
| POST | `/api/v1/admin/faults` | test-only fault injection (503 + Retry-After for N seconds) |  | 200 |
